title: ChSON Document
description: A structured format for knowledge fragments based on cognitive science principles of retrieval and chunking. Supports cheatsheets, checklists, runbooks, TLDRs, bookmarks, and more.

title.description: The name of this document (max 80 chars for readability).

version.description: Version of the subject matter this document covers.

publicationDate.description: When this document was published or last updated.

description.description: A brief summary of what this document covers (max 150 chars).

documentType.description: The type of document, which may influence rendering. 'cheatsheet': quick reference for commands/shortcuts. 'checklist': ordered tasks to complete. 'runbook': step-by-step operational procedures. 'tldr': brief summaries of topics. 'bookmarks': curated link collections.

author.description: The author or maintainer of this document.

homepage.description: URL of the official website or documentation for the subject matter.

icon.description: URL or relative path to an image representing this document (logo, icon, etc.).

retrievalDirection.description: Optional hint for renderers about the cognitive lookup direction. 'intent-to-mechanism': user knows what they want to do, needs the command/shortcut. 'mechanism-to-meaning': user sees a command/syntax, needs to understand what it does.

anchorLabel.description: Display name for the anchor column (default: 'Anchor', max 50 chars). Use 'Example' for code samples, 'Shortcut' for keyboard shortcuts, etc.

contentLabel.description: Display name for the content column (default: 'Content', max 50 chars). Use 'Description' for explanations, 'Action' for intent-based lookups, etc.

formatHints.description: Optional rendering hints for how to format anchor and content fields. When not specified, format is inferred from retrievalDirection: mechanism columns use 'code' format, intent columns use 'text' format. Markdown format supports inline code (`code`), bold (**text**), italics (*text*), and links ([text](url)).

anchor.description: Format hint for the anchor column. 'text': plain text. 'markdown': inline markdown (code, bold, italics, links). 'code': monospace code block.

content.description: Format hint for the content column. 'text': plain text. 'markdown': inline markdown (code, bold, italics, links). 'code': monospace code block.

title.description: The name of this section (max 100 chars for scannability).

description.description: Optional explanation of what this section covers.

entries.description: The anchor-content pairs in this section.

anchor.description: The retrieval anchor: what users scan for (max 100 chars). Typically a command, shortcut, or action name.

content.description: The associated content: what users need to know once they find the anchor (max 150 chars).

details.description: Extended explanation beyond the brief content (no length limit to support progressive disclosure). Typically interpreted as markdown by renderers.

url.description: Reference link to learn more about this entry.
